newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore shares open mixed in light volume.
newsitem.headline: Singapore shares open mixed in light volume.

text.p: Singapore shares were mixed at the open on Monday in light trading volume.
Dealers said sentiment was firmer after the Dow Jones Industrial index ended in positive territory on Friday.

"There was a lot of uncertainty last week but things settled down a bit on Friday and prices started to firm up. I think it will be a better week this week but it will also be quiet," said a trader with a local firm.
After 45 minutes of trading, the Straits Times Industrial index was off 2.30 points to 2,176.84. Volume was a light 9.75 million shares with 49 gainers against 19 losers.
Topping the actives was design firm Nobel Design which saw a block trade of one million shares at 51 Singapore cents.

Soft drinks group Fraser & Neave topped the losers with a 30 cent loss to S$14.60 with 116,000 units. The group announced an 18 percent rise in earings on Friday but said it expected its property profit earnings to fall in the current year.

Financial services group International Factors resumed trading and fell 20 cents to S$1.25 with 435,000 shares traded. The company's substantial shareholder ECICS Holdings said on Friday it decided not to consider any offers made for its stake in the company at the present moment.--Doreen Siow -65-8703092
